lines.text: As tall like? As tall as!
Many learners say: He is as tall like me.
Better: He is as tall as me.
Say as, then tall, then as.
As! He is as tall as me.

data.wrong: He is as tall like me.
data.right: He is as tall as me.
data.why: Say as, then tall, then as.

native.tip: En español “como” parece “like”, pero en esta comparación se dice “as”: “as tall as.”

en.tip: Learners turn “como” into “like”, but English says “as tall as.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “He is as tall like me.” “Tan… como” is “as… as”: “He is as tall as me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
